The '''Intimidator AN-21''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Kukri]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Intimidator AN-21 was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] in [[2017]], as part of the "Dread Warlord Pack" available in patch 5.2.2.
